TOWN OFNORTHFIELD[[87, 67, 427, 85]]
ZoningBoard of Appeals -Decision[[85, 104, 418, 125]]
TheCommitteehasreviewed the submitted materials and finds that the applicant has satisfied each of[[87, 165, 897, 183]]
theconditionsenumeratedinSection4ofthegoverning ordinance.Noticewaspublished in a[[86, 188, 834, 206]]
newspaperofgeneralcirculationnotlessthanfourteen daysbefore thehearing,and abutterswithin[[87, 213, 880, 231]]
threehundredfeetreceivedwrittennoticebycertifiedmail.Noobjectionwasreceivedfromany[[86, 237, 856, 255]]
abutter,andnomemberofthepublicappearedin oppositionatthehearingheldon thetwelfthofMay.[[86, 260, 906, 279]]
Accordingly,thevarianceisgrantedsubjecttothecondition thatconstruction commencewithintwelve[[88, 301, 909, 319]]
months of the date of this decision.Any person aggrieved by this decision may appeal to the Superior[[86, 325, 900, 343]]
CourtwithintwentydaysofthefilingofthisdecisionwiththeTownClerk[[86, 349, 689, 367]]
Filedwith the Town Clerk on14 May 2026.[[85, 860, 401, 879]]
